sql:
WITH repeat_customers AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey
  HAVING countDistinct(SalesOrderNumber) >= 2
)
SELECT
  pc.ProductCategoryName AS ProductCategoryName,
  sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.CustomerKey IN (SELECT CustomerKey FROM repeat_customers)) * 100.0
    / nullif(sum(f.SalesAmount), 0) AS RepeatCustomerSalesPct
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY RepeatCustomerSalesPct DESC
